channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Stephon Castle | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Stephon Castle from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Stephon Castle
item.description:
Tom Petrini:Wemby on Steph Castle:

“He might be the most mature player on our team,and he's nowhere near the oldest, and he's been in big games before. He's been in big games before the NBA. I'm not surprised by this, and he's shown over and over again that he's capable and that we are right to put our trust in him.”

Victor Wembanyama on Stephon Castle, Jun 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Reggie Miller on Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle
item.description:
“What’s going to be cool is some of my best moments as a basketball player were on NBC.I hope that five, 10, 15, 20 years from now, when I’m long gone from my broadcasting days, Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, those guys will remember their first game on NBC and hopefully they’ll be like, ‘Oh s—, Reggie Miller was calling our game!’ I hope I have that type of longevity.”

Reggie Miller on Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Stephon Castle, Deni Avdija
item.description:
Splitter on the Castle-Avdija dustup:

“Both teams playing very physical. I just thought that what Castle did was a little excessive and too much and then Deni just reacted, which is normal when you're trying to play and you try to win. I don't think it's a big deal.”

Tiago Splitter on Stephon Castle, Deni Avdija, Apr 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, Dylan Harper
item.description:
“I let the game come to me. Sometimes I attack the game a little more. But, at the end of the day, those guys (Wembanyama, Castle and Harper) are extremely talented. They understand the game at an extremely high level, and it's easy to play with them.”

De'Aaron Fox on Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, Dylan Harper, Apr 10, 2026. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Chris Paul on Stephon Castle
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Chris Paul on The Castle Show in last night's Risings Stars tournament:

“The thing that you could tell about him is that he's competitive,you know what I mean? That's one of the best things I think somebody could say about you. And it showed in that game.”

Chris Paul on Stephon Castle, Feb 15, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jaime Jaquez Jr on Stephon Castle
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Jaime Jaquez Jr. on what stands out most to him about Stephon Castle:

“Just tenacity. Just the way he plays the game. He's always aggressive,always wants to win, plays hard every possession. That's really what sticks out to me.”

Jaime Jaquez Jr on Stephon Castle, Feb 14, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Stephon Castle
item.description:
“His experience and his intelligence, as we know, is off the charts. He doesn't just talk to Steph Castle, he talks to everybody on the court, big, little, just been fantastic in that regard. He's basically been coaching along with playing, very honestly.”

Gregg Popovich on Stephon Castle, Oct 6, 2024. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Brian Wright on Stephon Castle
item.description:
Spurs GM Brian Wright on Stephon Castle:

“He’d been somebody that we knew a lot about. When the opportunity was there, we drafted him.”

Brian Wright on Stephon Castle, Jun 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.
